courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 高速鐵路軌道超高配置
related.titleEn: Cant design for high-speed railway curves
related.transfer: 可遷移「圓曲線向心加速」與「坡度接續長度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高速鐵路軌道超高配置的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Circular-curve acceleration" and "Grade-transition length" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Cant design for high-speed railway curves must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦平縱曲線連續性與高速動態舒適性；高速鐵路軌道超高配置則以曲線超高不足與混合速度的取捨為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on alignment continuity and high-speed dynamic comfort; Cant design for high-speed railway curves centres on cant deficiency and mixed-speed trade-offs, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「圓曲線向心加速」與「平衡超高計算」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高速鐵路軌道超高配置，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「不足變化時間率」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Circular-curve acceleration” and “Equilibrium cant calculation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cant design for high-speed railway curves, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Deficiency change rate", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 軌道扣件彈性設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「圓曲線向心加速」與「坡度接續長度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；軌道扣件彈性設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.difference: 本課聚焦平縱曲線連續性與高速動態舒適性；軌道扣件彈性設計則以扣件預壓彈性絕緣與疲勞的共同設計為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on alignment continuity and high-speed dynamic comfort; Resilient rail-fastening design centres on fastener preload resilience insulation and fatigue design, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「圓曲線向心加速」與「墊片壓縮剛度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到軌道扣件彈性設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「絕緣電阻量級」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Circular-curve acceleration” and “Pad compression stiffness”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Resilient rail-fastening design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Insulation resistance scale", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高速鐵路路線平縱面設計
history.titleEn: Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail
history.text: 本課把高速鐵路路線平縱面設計放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。路線設計先建立平面與高程共同里程，再檢查曲率、坡度和變化率；地形可行的中心線仍可能因高速動態需求而需要更長緩和段。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Horizontal and vertical alignment for high-speed rail in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Alignment design uses a shared chainage for plan and elevation before checking curvature, gradient and their rates; a terrain-feasible centreline may still require longer transitions for high-speed dynamics. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models

history.textEn: The course turns "Circular-curve acceleration" through "Alignment uncertainty combination" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
